name: WHERE Block (Masked Array Assignment)
description: Masked elemental operations — condition becomes boolean mask, ELSEWHERE clause, fir.if inside hlfir.elemental
key_patterns: SELECT + predicated store in LLVM IR
source:
subroutine safe_sqrt(result, input, n)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in)  :: n
  real,    intent(in)  :: input(n)
  real,    intent(out) :: result(n)

  WHERE (input > 0.0)
    result = SQRT(input)
  ELSEWHERE
    result = 0.0
  END WHERE

end subroutine safe_sqrt

llvm_ir.content:
; ModuleID = '03_where_block.f90'
source_filename = "03_where_block.f90"
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

declare float @llvm.sqrt.f32(float) #1

define void @_QPsafe_sqrt(
    ptr nocapture %0,           ; result(:)
    ptr nocapture readonly %1,  ; input(:)
    ptr nocapture readonly %2   ; n
) #0 !dbg !5 {
entry:
  %n_val = load i32, ptr %2, align 4, !dbg !10
  %n_ext = sext i32 %n_val to i64
  %guard = icmp sgt i64 %n_ext, 0
  br i1 %guard, label %loop.ph, label %exit

loop.ph:
  br label %loop

loop:                           ; preds = %loop.ph, %loop
  %iv = phi i64 [ 0, %loop.ph ], [ %iv.next, %loop ], !dbg !11

  ; Load input element and test mask condition
  %in_ptr  = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %1, i64 %iv, !dbg !11
  %in_val  = load float, ptr %in_ptr, align 4, !dbg !11
  %mask    = fcmp ogt float %in_val, 0.000000e+00, !dbg !11  ; WHERE condition

  ; Compute both branches (scalar); SELECT picks the result
  ; Flang does not speculate math.sqrt on masked WHERE — uses select
  %sq_val  = call float @llvm.sqrt.f32(float %in_val), !dbg !12
  %res_val = select i1 %mask, float %sq_val, float 0.000000e+00, !dbg !12

  ; Store to result(:)
  %res_ptr = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %0, i64 %iv, !dbg !12
  store float %res_val, ptr %res_ptr, align 4, !dbg !12

  %iv.next = add nuw nsw i64 %iv, 1
  %done    = icmp eq i64 %iv.next, %n_ext
  br i1 %done, label %exit, label %loop

exit:
  ret void, !dbg !13
}

correlations.lowering_notes: The WHERE mask expression lowers to a masked hlfir.elemental that produces !hlfir.expr<?x!fir.logical<4>>. In HLFIR the SQRT body and ELSEWHERE 0.0 are merged into a single elemental using arith.select — the compiler does not emit two separate loops. At LLVM IR level this becomes fcmp + select in the loop body, allowing the vectorizer to use masked SIMD blend instructions.

SQRT is an elemental intrinsic that lowers to math.sqrt in MLIR (not a runtime call), which maps to @llvm.sqrt.f32 — a target-agnostic LLVM intrinsic. The WHERE guard is encoded as an arith.select rather than a branch, enabling branchless SIMD vectorization.

lowering_patterns.name: WHERE Mask → arith.select (branchless)
lowering_patterns.description: Flang lowers WHERE/ELSEWHERE pairs into a single hlfir.elemental body using arith.select rather than control flow branches, enabling LLVM to vectorize with SIMD blend/select instructions

lowering_patterns.name: Elemental Intrinsic (SQRT) → math dialect → llvm.sqrt
lowering_patterns.description: Fortran elemental intrinsics pass through the MLIR math dialect (math.sqrt) before being lowered to LLVM target-agnostic intrinsics (@llvm.sqrt.f32), keeping the IR portable across targets
